title: Best Ex Nihilo Perfume: How to Sample Before You Buy
summary: Find your signature Ex Nihilo perfume with this guide to sampling, discovery sets, and choosing the right fragrance for you.
body_markdown:
Walk through any department store, and you might start to feel like you’re smelling the same few perfumes on repeat. If you’re tired of mass-market scents and searching for something that truly feels like *you* , it’s time to get acquainted with[Ex Nihilo.](https://www.scentbird.com/brand/ex-nihilo) This Parisian brand was built for the person who doesn’t want to smell like everyone else. They threw out the traditional rulebook, focusing instead on pure creation, high-quality ingredients, and artistic expression. The result is a collection of unique, memorable, and often polarizing fragrances that are anything but boring. If you’re ready to find a signature scent that stands out, an **Ex Nihilo perfume** is the perfect place to start your search.


## Key Takeaways


- **Choose Artistry Over Trends** : Ex Nihilo’s core philosophy is to create unique scents from scratch, offering you a fragrance that feels personal and stands apart from what’s popular.
- **Sample Smartly Before You Splurge** : You don’t have to buy a full bottle to experience the brand. Use their discovery sets to test multiple scents, and the money you spend becomes a credit toward your final choice.
- **Invest in Quality That Lasts** : The higher price point reflects exceptional ingredients and impressive longevity. A few sprays will last all day, making it a worthwhile investment in a signature scent.


## What Makes Ex Nihilo So Special?


In a world full of legacy perfume houses,[Ex Nihilo](https://www.scentbird.com/brand/ex-nihilo) arrived on the scene as a modern, disruptive force. Founded in Paris, this brand has quickly built a reputation for its avant-garde approach to luxury fragrance. It’s not just about creating beautiful scents; it’s about challenging the conventions of traditional perfumery. From their core philosophy to their use of cutting-edge technology, every detail is designed to offer a unique and personal experience. They stand out by blending radical creative freedom with the finest raw materials, creating a collection that feels both timeless and completely new.


### Its “Created from Nothing” Philosophy


The name itself tells you everything you need to know. “Ex Nihilo” is a Latin expression that means “created from nothing.” This idea is the brand’s guiding principle. When the founders started the company in 2013, they wanted to build a fragrance house from scratch, free from the constraints of established brands. Their[creative manifesto](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/la-maison) is all about starting with a blank slate to create something entirely original. This philosophy means they aren’t trying to follow trends or replicate past successes. Instead, they focus on pure creation, resulting in scents that are distinctive and unexpected. It’s a fresh perspective in an industry often rooted in tradition.


### Giving Perfumers Total Creative Freedom


One of the most significant ways Ex Nihilo stands out is by giving its perfumers what they call “Carte Blanche”—total creative freedom. In the fragrance industry, perfumers are often given a strict brief, complete with target demographics and budget limitations. Ex Nihilo throws that rulebook out the window. They collaborate with some of the best noses in the world and give them the freedom to explore any idea and use the most exquisite raw materials without restriction. This trust in artistry is what leads to such bold and memorable fragrances. You can feel the perfumer’s personal touch in every bottle, making each scent a true work of art.


### Blending Modern Art with Classic Craftsmanship


Ex Nihilo perfectly marries the heritage of French perfumery with a forward-thinking, modern edge. They honor traditional craftsmanship by sourcing the finest ingredients from around the globe, but they aren’t afraid to innovate. The brand is a pioneer in using advanced techniques, including biotechnology, to create new scent profiles that simply weren’t possible before. This fusion of old and new allows them to craft fragrances that are both sophisticated and surprising. They respect the past but are firmly focused on the future of fragrance, creating a collection that feels both classic and completely contemporary.


### Create Your Own Scent with The Osmologue


For the ultimate personal touch, Ex Nihilo offers a one-of-a-kind bespoke fragrance service. In their flagship boutiques, you’ll find the Osmologue, a high-tech machine that allows you to customize their signature scents. You can work with a fragrance expert to weigh and blend precious raw materials, adding your own twist to iconic creations like Fleur Narcotique. This personalization program transforms the act of buying a perfume into an immersive, creative experience. It’s the perfect expression of their commitment to individuality, allowing you to walk away with a scent that is truly and uniquely yours.


## The Ex Nihilo Scents You Need to Know


With a collection as creative and diverse as Ex Nihilo’s, it can be tough to know where to start. The brand has a knack for creating scents that feel both timeless and completely new. From hypnotic florals to innovative alcohol-free formulas, these are the fragrances that have captured the attention of perfume lovers everywhere. If you’re ready to find your next signature scent, here are five essential Ex Nihilo perfumes to get to know.


### Blue Talisman: Fresh Citrus Meets Warm Woods


Think of Blue Talisman as your secret weapon—a scent that’s both energizing and grounding. It opens with a bright burst of fresh citrus that feels clean and modern, but it quickly settles into a sophisticated base of warm woods. This contrast creates a captivating and long-lasting fragrance that feels incredibly chic. It’s a newer, more powerful take on one of the brand’s popular perfumes, making it a perfect choice for anyone who wants a scent that is both subtle and unforgettable. It’s the kind of fragrance that works for any occasion, from a day at the office to a night out.


### Fleur Narcotique: Peony, Jasmine, and Lychee Elegance


There’s a reason Fleur Narcotique is one of Ex Nihilo’s most iconic fragrances. This scent is pure floral sophistication in a bottle. It’s an elegant blend of lush peony, delicate jasmine, and a surprising twist of sweet lychee that adds a juicy, modern feel. The result is a fragrance that’s feminine and alluring without being overpowering. It smells like walking through a Parisian garden in full bloom. If you’re a fan of complex floral scents that make a statement, this is one you absolutely have to[experience](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/) . It’s a masterpiece that truly lives up to its name.


### Lust in Paradise: Tropical Coconut and Pineapple Escape


If you’ve ever wanted to bottle the feeling of a sun-soaked getaway, this is it. Lust in Paradise is a dreamy, transportive fragrance that instantly makes you feel like you’re on vacation. It’s a beautiful blend of tropical notes, with creamy coconut and juicy pineapple taking center stage. A touch of white peony keeps it feeling light and airy, preventing it from becoming overly sweet. It’s a popular choice for good reason—it’s a happy, carefree scent that’s perfect for warm weather or anytime you need a little[olfactory escape](https://www.fragrantica.com/designers/Ex-Nihilo.html) . One spritz, and you’ll be dreaming of white sand beaches and turquoise water.


### Sweet Morphine: Vanilla and Tonka Bean Indulgence


For those who love warm, inviting, and slightly addictive scents, Sweet Morphine is a must-try. This fragrance is a beautiful and indulgent blend of creamy vanilla and rich tonka bean, creating a scent that feels like a soft, luxurious hug. It has a powdery, almond-like quality that is both comforting and deeply sensual. It’s often highlighted as a favorite for its cozy yet sophisticated profile. While it’s sweet, it’s balanced with delicate florals that keep it from being overwhelming. It’s the perfect scent for a cozy night in or a romantic evening out, wrapping you in a warm and memorable embrace.


### Generation(S): Alcohol-Free Luxury Innovation


Ex Nihilo continues to push boundaries with its unique product offerings, and GENERATION(S) is a perfect example. This is an alcohol-free eau de parfum designed for those who want a luxury fragrance experience without the alcohol, which can be irritating for sensitive skin. This innovative formula uses a milky, micro-emulsion base that feels soft on the skin while still delivering a long-lasting scent. It proves you don’t have to compromise on quality or performance to find a gentle fragrance. It’s a testament to the brand’s commitment to blending modern science with classic perfumery, offering something for every[fragrance lover](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/collections/all-our-fragrances) .


## How Much Do Ex Nihilo Perfumes Cost?


Let’s talk about the price tag. Ex Nihilo is a luxury niche brand, and its pricing reflects the artistry, high-quality ingredients, and creative freedom that go into every bottle. When you invest in one of their scents, you’re not just buying a perfume; you’re acquiring a piece of olfactory art that’s designed to be unique and memorable. While it’s definitely a splurge compared to mainstream designer fragrances, understanding the cost helps you see the value behind it.


The good news is that you don’t have to commit to a full bottle right away to experience what makes the brand so special. There are more accessible ways to explore their collection, which is perfect if you’re still figuring out your signature scent. Think of it as a tiered system: you can dip your toes in with samples, get a feel for the brand with a discovery set, or go all-in on a full bottle once you’ve found “the one.” This approach lets you find a scent you truly love without the pressure of a big upfront purchase.


### A Look at Their Pricing


When you’re ready to invest in a full bottle, it’s helpful to know what to expect. Prices for Ex Nihilo’s full-size perfumes generally start around $165 and can go up to $490 for larger, more concentrated versions like the Quintessence collection. This price range places the brand firmly in the luxury niche category. You’re paying for the exceptional raw materials and the perfumer’s unique vision. You can explore[all their fragrances](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/collections/all-our-fragrances?srsltid=AfmBOorRx4-ASZcxlgJ5SDYUCv_qEdFz--5fS01eBG7e8pRsSUfNjNpY) on their site to see the full range of options and sizes available.


### The $50 Discovery Set (and Its Hidden Value)


If you want to try different scents before buying a big bottle, the brand’s[Discovery Set](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/?srsltid=AfmBOoqmJm1XNeaSUPQG0cO5Fw_dXeWnEVJjQiN7rA_ChNBApuPuvrK-) is a fantastic option for $50. This is one of the smartest ways to get acquainted with their most popular creations without the full-bottle commitment. It’s a curated experience that lets you live with the scents, see how they wear on your skin, and decide which one truly speaks to you. For anyone who loves to sample and explore—which is what we’re all about—this is the perfect entry point into the world of Ex Nihilo.


### How It Compares to Other Niche Brands


So, how does Ex Nihilo stack up against other niche perfume houses? Its pricing is competitive within the world of artisanal fragrance. According to the[fragrance community at Fragrantica](https://www.fragrantica.com/designers/Ex-Nihilo.html) , EX NIHILO is a great choice for people who want perfumes that stand out and are not mass-produced. Unlike fragrances you can find in any department store, these scents are crafted with a distinct point of view. When you compare it to other brands that prioritize unique ingredients and small-batch production, you’ll find the cost is right in line with the quality and exclusivity you receive.


## How to Sample Ex Nihilo Before You Buy


Committing to a niche fragrance is a big step, especially with a luxury price tag. The last thing you want is to invest in a full bottle only to realize it doesn’t quite work with your skin chemistry. Luckily, Ex Nihilo makes it easy to explore their collection without the immediate commitment. This is the smartest way to find a scent you’ll truly love and wear with confidence.


Of course, the easiest way to try Ex Nihilo is by adding one of their iconic scents, like[Fleur Narcotique](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/ex-nihilo-fleur-narcotique-2389) , to your Scentbird queue. But if you want to explore directly from the brand, they offer a few great options that let you test their fragrances on your own time, in your own space. This approach ensures your final choice is one you’ll be happy with for a long time.


**Sample Ex Nihilo Through Scentbird**


If you’d rather skip the upfront cost of a discovery set altogether, a Scentbird subscription is the lowest-commitment way in. You can browse[Ex Nihilo’s full collection on Scentbird](https://www.scentbird.com/brand/ex-nihilo) and add a scent like Fleur Narcotique to your monthly queue for a fraction of the price of a full bottle. You’ll get a generous 30-day supply to wear the fragrance in real life — at the office, on a night out, through all the moments a quick store spritz can’t show you — before deciding whether it earns a spot on your vanity for good.


### Try a Discovery Set


If you’re new to the brand and not sure where to start, the best entry point is an[Ex Nihilo Discovery Set](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/collections/discovery-sets) . For $50, you can get a curated collection of their most popular fragrances, allowing you to experience the brand’s range and artistry. It’s the perfect way to test multiple scents over several days to see how they evolve on your skin from the first spritz to the final dry-down. This gives you a much better feel for a fragrance than a quick spray at a department store ever could.


### Buy Individual Samples


Maybe you’ve already done some research and have a few specific scents in mind. In that case, you can create your own personalized sample set. Ex Nihilo allows you to[select six different 2ml perfume samples](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/products/sample-set) to try at home. This tailored approach is perfect for comparing the fragrances you’re most curious about side-by-side. It puts you in the driver’s seat, letting you focus your exploration on the notes and scent families you’re naturally drawn to, ensuring you get the most out of your sampling experience.


### Get a Credit Toward a Full Bottle


Here’s the best part: your sampling cost isn’t just money spent—it’s an investment in your future purchase. When you buy a Discovery Set or a custom sample set, Ex Nihilo includes a gift voucher for the same amount you paid. You can then apply this credit toward a full-size bottle (50ml or 100ml) of your favorite scent from the set. The voucher is valid for 30 days, giving you plenty of time to make a decision. Think of it as getting your samples for free if you decide to buy a bottle.


## Find Your Perfect Ex Nihilo Scent


Choosing a niche fragrance can feel like a big commitment, but it’s really about matching a scent to your personality and the mood you want to create. Whether you’re looking for an everyday signature or a special occasion showstopper, Ex Nihilo has a carefully crafted scent that will feel like it was made just for you. Think of this as your personal guide to finding the one.


### If You Love Fresh and Vibrant Scents


For those who gravitate toward clean, bright, and uplifting fragrances, **Lust in Paradise** is your perfect match. It’s a beautiful blend of white peony and pink pepper that feels like sunshine on the French Riviera. This is the kind of scent you can wear anywhere, from a casual brunch to a day at the office. Fans often describe it as a “beautiful and refreshing scent that’s perfect for everyday wear.” It’s effortlessly chic and instantly puts you in a good mood without ever feeling overpowering. If you want a fragrance that feels like a crisp white shirt and a fresh start, this is it.


### If You Want to Make a Statement


When you want a fragrance that enters the room before you do, reach for **Blue Talisman** . This is a bold, hypnotic scent designed to leave a memorable impression. With notes of pear, bergamot, and soft musks, it has a captivating quality that draws people in. It’s the ideal choice for evenings out or any time you want to feel confident and powerful. One[fragrance reviewer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T_2gk1VzoDM) even called it a “10 out of a 10 fragrance,” highlighting its undeniable appeal and head-turning effect. It’s a modern scent that feels both powerful and sophisticated.


### If You’re Drawn to Romantic Florals


If your fragrance collection is filled with soft, feminine, and floral notes, you will fall in love with **Fleur Narcotique** . This scent is an icon for a reason. It’s a delicate yet complex bouquet of peony, lychee, and jasmine that feels both modern and timelessly romantic. It’s an incredibly alluring fragrance that’s perfect for date nights or simply when you want to feel your most beautiful. As one of the brand’s most[iconic creations](https://en.newsroom.eurazeo.com/news/eurazeo-completes-investment-in-parisian-niche-fragrance-brand-ex-nihilo-04bb5-52e2c.html) , it perfectly captures the sophisticated and artistic spirit of the house.


### If You’re Looking for Something Different


Maybe you don’t want to fit into a specific box. If you’re searching for a scent that feels entirely new and unique, the entire Ex Nihilo collection is worth exploring. The brand was built on the idea of breaking away from the norms of traditional perfumery. Each fragrance is crafted to be a work of art, telling its own distinct story. For those who want to express their individuality,[Ex Nihilo perfumes](https://www.fragrantica.com/designers/Ex-Nihilo.html) offer a chance to wear something that feels personal and stands out from the mainstream luxury market. It’s the perfect brand for anyone who values artistry and originality in their scent choices.


## What Are People *Really* Saying About Ex Nihilo?


When you’re exploring a niche fragrance house, it helps to hear from people who have already worn the scents. Ex Nihilo inspires a lot of conversation online, from detailed reviews on fragrance blogs to quick takes on social media. While every perfume experience is personal, looking at the general consensus can give you a good idea of what to expect. From performance to the overall vibe, here’s a breakdown of the common themes you’ll find when you look up reviews for this Parisian brand.


These aren’t your average department store perfumes, so the feedback is often more passionate and specific. People tend to focus on four key areas: how long the scents last, their unique and often polarizing nature, the undeniable feeling of luxury, and the exceptional quality of the ingredients. Understanding these points can help you decide which Ex Nihilo fragrance might be the right one for you to try next. It’s like getting recommendations from a friend who has already done all the sampling for you.


### How Long Do the Scents Last?


One of the biggest questions with any fragrance is, “Will it last all day?” For many fans, Ex Nihilo delivers. The brand has built a strong following, with one fragrance reviewer declaring that “[Ex Nihilo are one of my favourite niche fragrance houses](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Eqyb9Kr8ZI) ,” a sentiment often tied to the impressive longevity of their perfumes. Because niche brands often use a higher concentration of high-quality perfume oils, you’ll find that a few spritzes in the morning can carry you through the evening. This lasting power is a huge plus, especially given the price point, as it means your bottle (or your Scentbird vial) will go a long way.


### The Love-It-or-Hate-It Factor


Don’t be surprised if you find that Ex Nihilo scents are a bit polarizing—that’s part of their charm. These aren’t simple, one-note fragrances designed to please everyone. They are complex, artistic creations that tend to evoke strong reactions. As one perfume critic noted, “[People either hate the fragrance or they love it](https://persolaise.com/2015/08/persolaise-review-ex-nihilo.html) .” This isn’t a drawback; it’s a sign of a truly unique scent profile. If you’re tired of smelling like everyone else, the distinctiveness of an Ex Nihilo perfume is a major selling point. It’s for the person who wants their fragrance to be a conversation starter.


### The Feeling of True Luxury


There’s no denying that Ex Nihilo operates in the high-end fragrance space. The brand is consistently described as a “[luxury perfume brand from Paris, known for its unique and high-quality fragrances](https://en.newsroom.eurazeo.com/news/eurazeo-completes-investment-in-parisian-niche-fragrance-brand-ex-nihilo-04bb5-52e2c.html) .” This sense of luxury isn’t just about the price; it’s woven into the entire experience. From the minimalist, weighty bottles to the sophisticated scent compositions, everything feels intentional and elevated. Wearing an Ex Nihilo fragrance feels like a special occasion, even if you’re just running errands. It’s a small way to add a touch of Parisian chic to your daily routine and feel a little more put-together.


### Praise for High-Quality Ingredients


At the heart of Ex Nihilo’s appeal is its commitment to craftsmanship. The brand is known to work with famous perfumers and “[use the best ingredients](https://en.newsroom.eurazeo.com/news/eurazeo-completes-investment-in-parisian-niche-fragrance-brand-ex-nihilo-04bb5-52e2c.html) ,” and you can truly smell the difference. Instead of harsh, synthetic notes, you get scents that feel smooth, rich, and multi-dimensional. The raw materials are carefully sourced, allowing the natural beauty of ingredients like peony, lychee, or sandalwood to shine through. This focus on quality is what separates a good fragrance from a great one, and it’s a key reason why so many perfume lovers are willing to invest in the brand.


## So, Is Ex Nihilo Worth the Price Tag?


Let’s talk about the elephant in the room: the price. Ex Nihilo fragrances are an investment, and it’s fair to ask if they live up to the hype. When you’re spending this much on a perfume, you want to know you’re getting more than just a pretty bottle. The short answer is that you’re paying for a combination of exceptional performance, artistic vision, and a level of exclusivity you just don’t find on every department store counter. It’s a luxury experience from start to finish, but whether it’s the right splurge for you depends on what you value in a scent.


### Breaking Down the Performance


When it comes to performance, Ex Nihilo delivers. These aren’t the kind of scents that disappear after an hour. Most of their fragrances have[impressive longevity](https://www.fragrantica.com/designers/Ex-Nihilo.html) and a beautiful sillage—that lovely scent trail you leave behind. For those who want an even more powerful experience, the brand offers stronger ‘Extrait de Parfum’ versions of popular scents like Blue Talisman and Fleur Narcotique. These have a higher concentration of perfume oils, making them incredibly potent and long-lasting. You’re getting a high-quality formulation that performs consistently, so a little goes a long way.


### You’re Paying for Artistry and Uniqueness


With Ex Nihilo, you’re not just buying a perfume; you’re buying a piece of art. The brand’s name literally means “Created out of the blue,” which speaks to their core philosophy. They give their perfumers complete creative freedom to craft unique, avant-garde scents without the pressure of mass-market appeal. This approach results in fragrances that feel both modern and timeless. By focusing on[luxury craftsmanship](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/la-maison) and collaborating with artists, Ex Nihilo creates scents that tell a story. The price reflects this commitment to originality and the high-quality raw materials used in every bottle.


### How It Stacks Up Against Designer Perfumes


So, how does Ex Nihilo compare to the designer fragrances you might be more familiar with? While many designer scents are created to be widely popular, Ex Nihilo’s goal is the opposite. They intentionally create fragrances that are distinctive and unconventional, aiming to be different from common luxury brands. Think of it this way: a designer perfume is like a perfectly tailored classic suit, while an Ex Nihilo scent is a custom-made couture gown. Both are beautiful, but one is designed for a much more personal and exclusive experience. It’s for the person who doesn’t want to smell like everyone else.


## Where to Buy Authentic Ex Nihilo Perfumes


When you’re ready to invest in a luxury fragrance, the last thing you want is to end up with a fake. Getting your hands on an authentic Ex Nihilo perfume is key to experiencing the artistry and quality that makes the brand so special. Counterfeits can’t replicate the complex notes or the high-quality ingredients that define these scents. To make sure you’re getting the real deal, it’s best to stick to a few trusted sources. This way, you can be confident that the fragrance you’re buying is exactly what the perfumer intended.


### Shop Directly from Their Website


The most straightforward way to guarantee authenticity is to buy directly from the source. The[official Ex Nihilo website](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/la-maison) is your best bet for finding their complete collection, including the latest releases and online exclusives. When you purchase from them, you know you’re receiving a genuine product straight from the brand. It eliminates any guesswork and ensures the perfume has been stored properly and is in perfect condition. Plus, you can explore their full brand story and get a feel for the philosophy behind each creation while you shop. It’s the most reliable way to start your Ex Nihilo journey.


### Find an Authorized Retailer


If you prefer to test scents in person before committing, visiting an authorized retailer is a great option. Ex Nihilo partners with high-end department stores and select specialty perfume shops around the world. You can find their fragrances in cities like Paris, London, and Los Angeles. Shopping at one of these[approved locations](https://us.ex-nihilo-paris.com/?srsltid=AfmBOoqmJm1XNeaSUPQG0cO5Fw_dXeWnEVJjQiN7rA_ChNBApuPuvrK-) allows you to experience the scents firsthand and often get personalized recommendations from knowledgeable staff. It’s a fantastic way to compare different fragrances and find the one that truly speaks to you, turning your purchase into a memorable experience.


### How to Avoid Fakes Online


In the world of online shopping, if a deal on a luxury item seems too good to be true, it usually is. To avoid counterfeit products, be cautious of third-party sellers on large marketplace sites. An authentic Ex Nihilo fragrance is defined by its[luxury craftsmanship](https://en.newsroom.eurazeo.com/news/eurazeo-completes-investment-in-parisian-niche-fragrance-brand-ex-nihilo-04bb5-52e2c.html) and complex formulation, which fakes simply cannot match. Always verify that you’re buying from a reputable, authorized source. Cross-reference prices with the official website—a drastically lower price is a major red flag. Sticking to official channels is the safest way to ensure you’re investing in the true Ex Nihilo experience.


## Frequently Asked Questions


**What’s the best Ex Nihilo fragrance for a beginner?** If you’re just getting started with the brand, you can’t go wrong with Fleur Narcotique. It’s their most iconic scent for a reason and beautifully captures the house’s modern, sophisticated style. It’s a complex floral that is surprisingly easy to wear. For something a bit brighter and more casual, Lust in Paradise is another fantastic choice that feels like an instant mood-lifter.


**Are Ex Nihilo perfumes considered unisex?** Yes, absolutely. While some fragrances may feature traditionally feminine notes like peony or masculine notes like wood, Ex Nihilo encourages you to wear whatever scent you connect with. The world of niche perfumery is less about marketing to a specific gender and more about creating a unique experience, so feel free to explore the entire collection to find what works for you.


**Why are these perfumes so much more expensive than designer brands?** The price reflects the brand’s commitment to artistry and quality over mass appeal. You’re paying for the exceptional, often rare, raw materials and the complete creative freedom given to world-class perfumers. Unlike designer brands that often create scents to follow trends, Ex Nihilo focuses on crafting unique, small-batch fragrances that are more like wearable art.


**What makes Fleur Narcotique so popular?** Fleur Narcotique has a special kind of magic that makes it stand out from other floral perfumes. Its genius is in the balance. The blend of lush peony and jasmine is classic and beautiful, but the unexpected twist of juicy lychee gives it a modern, almost electric quality. It’s sophisticated without feeling stuffy and alluring without being overpowering, making it a truly captivating and memorable scent.


**How long will a sample or Scentbird vial last?** A small 2ml sample from a discovery set is perfect for testing a fragrance a few times to see how it wears on your skin. If you want to truly get to know a scent, a Scentbird vial is the ideal next step. The 8ml size holds about 120 sprays, which is more than enough for you to wear it daily for a full month and decide if it’s worth investing in a full bottle.
